#!/bin/bash
echo '=== Listening ports ==='
ss -tuln 2>/dev/null || netstat -tuln 2>/dev/null
echo '=== Processes ==='
ps aux
echo '=== Users ==='
cat /etc/passwd
echo '=== SSH keys in /home ==='
find /home -type f \( -name '*.pem' -o -name 'id_rsa' -o -name 'id_ed25519' -o -name 'id_dsa' -o -name 'authorized_keys' -o -name '*.key' \) 2>/dev/null
echo '=== SSH keys in /root ==='
find /root -type f \( -name '*.pem' -o -name 'id_rsa' -o -name 'id_ed25519' -o -name 'id_dsa' -o -name 'authorized_keys' -o -name '*.key' \) 2>/dev/null
echo '=== Config files in /etc ==='
find /etc -type f \( -name '*.conf' -o -name '*.yaml' -o -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.json' -o -name '*.xml' \) 2>/dev/null | head -30
echo '=== Environment ==='
env
